integrity: Mathematical proof is analytic; finite simulations and numerical checks are corroboration, not proof. The pairwise 1/8 probability is known and excluded from novelty.

Only a Gaussian limit for positive length variance; the distributional limit for fixed arc length is not claimed.
Related historical spherical needle literature may contain intermediate equivalent identities.
title: Geodesic-needle crossing networks: exact star spectrum and a variance transition
